caption: The drawing depicts a metallic cylindrical container with a conical top, similar to a watering can or oil can, centered on a plain background. The container has a tall, vertical form, and is primarily rendered in shades of gray and blue to suggest a reflective metal surface. The can features a thin, vertically oriented handle made from a bent wire attached to the top, and two spouts: one short and curved, colored in dull orange or copper tones, and a longer straight spout extending downward at an angle, colored in gray and black. The entire object sits on a slight circular base, indicated by a thin outline that suggests shadow and grounding. The background is a muted beige, and a thin, rectangular border frames the composition. There is visible shading around the object to convey dimensionality, and the highlights and shadows on the can emphasize its metallic texture.
title: Lamp
